title: EDHOC+OSCORE c5c (C509 cert by value) handshake over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: EDHOC Method 0 with C509 cert-by-value (c5c) credentials over TSCH. Server (node 2) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; client (node 1). Compact C509 cert (~164 B) carried in-band -> smaller MSG_2/MSG_3 than x5c -> fewer fragments -> lower latency. UDGM lossless. PASSES on the client's end-to-end PASSED line; read 'EDHOC finished' for handshake latency.
